verdict.rationale: Extend documents zero data retention options, including ZDR with AI subprocessors configurable at the workspace level, and lists ZDR on its pricing page. Its compliance page cites SOC 2 Type II-aligned controls with reports in a Trust Center, and pricing offers a HIPAA compliance and BAA add-on. Together these cover processing contracts and medical records under ZDR, SOC 2 and HIPAA. Missing for 10: an explicit SOC 2 Type II attestation (the docs only say controls are "aligned with" it), clarity on which billing tiers include ZDR and HIPAA (HIPAA is an add-on), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the retention behavior.
